title: AI Transformation Engineer
description: Rydoo is a fast-growing international SaaS company in spend management, helping companies streamline how they capture, control and report employee and company spend. Our platform offers expense management and accounts payable for thousands of enterprise customers across 130+ countries. We are backed by strong private equity partners and continue to scale rapidly, with a growing footprint in Europe and the US. We are a team of :200 people, representing 30+ nationalities. We move fast, work pragmatically and care deeply about building software for modern finance teams. Role Purpose At Rydoo, AI is a key lever to improve how we operate internally: faster execution, better decisions, and reduced manual work. To unlock this potential, we are creating a dedicated role focused on building and deploying AI-powered solutions for internal teams. You will connect data across our internal systems, create the shared building blocks that AI solutions sit on, and deliver the larger internal projects end to end. Alongside that, you will ship focused use cases with individual teams (Sales, Finance, Customer Success, HR, Product). The Role You are a builder, one who cares about what happens after the demo. Your mission is to turn AI opportunities into deployed, reliable solutions that teams use every day, and to make each one cheaper and faster to build than the last by investing in shared data access, integrations and tooling. You will not work on Rydoo's customer-facing product, but on internal tools, automations, and workflows that increase efficiency and quality across the company. You will collaborate closely with the AI Transformation Lead and business teams to identify needs, prioritise use cases, and deliver solutions end-to-end. What Will You Do Use case development & delivery Translate business needs into concrete AI solutions Design, build, and deploy internal tools powered by AI (LLMs, automation, workflows) Move quickly from prototype to production-ready solutions Ensure solutions are reliable, usable, and scalable Cross-functional collaboration Work directly with teams (Sales, Finance, CS, HR, etc.) to understand their workflows Help prioritise the most impactful use cases Act as the bridge between what is technically possible and what is operationally useful Enable teams to adopt and use the solutions you build Product & technical ownership Take ownership of internal AI products from ideation to deployment Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, quality, and scalability Continuously improve solutions based on feedback and usage Ensure a strong focus on user experience and adoption Tooling, automation & integrations Build automations using tools such as APIs, no-code/low-code platforms, and custom scripts Integrate AI capabilities into existing systems (CRM, support tools, finance tools, etc.) Leverage multiple models and providers depending on the use case Ensure robustness and maintainability of what you build AI experimentation & innovation Stay up to date with the latest AI tools and capabilities Rapidly test new approaches and identify what works in practice Bring new ideas proactively to the organization Governance & best practices Ensure secure and compliant use of data in all solutions Follow and contribute to internal AI guidelines Balance experimentation with responsible usage What success looks like (12-18 months) Multiple AI-powered internal tools are in production and used weekly by the teams they were built for Clear productivity gains are observed in key workflows A pipeline of new AI use cases is continuously identified and executed Solutions are robust, scalable, and well adopted Requirements 3-8 years of experience in software engineering, product engineering, or similar roles Hands-on experience putting LLM-based solutions into production, not only prototyping them Experience making a solution reliable after launch: evaluation, testing, monitoring, handling failure cases Familiarity with SaaS environments and tech stack (Salesforce, Slack, M365, Snowflake, ...) Technical Skills Strong data and integration skills: SQL, API, data modelling, pipelines, working across systems that were not always designed to talk to each other Experience with automation tools (e.g. Zapier, Make, or equivalent) is a plus Ability to work with multiple AI models and understand their trade-offs Solid engineering fundamentals & coding knowledge Mindset & Capabilities Builder mindset: you like shipping things that work Strong business intuition: you focus on real user impact Able to operate in ambiguity and define your own roadmap Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams Curious, fast learner, and hands-on with new tools Why this role is interesting You work on high-impact problems across the entire company You build real solutions that people use every day You are at the forefront of applying AI in a practical business context You have a direct impact on productivity and company performance Company-wide scope, from finance
